title: Kernel behavior
label: Kernel behavior
checked: Execution state across cells, stream order and completeness, output written to the engine's own descriptors, interrupts, completion offsets, and process cleanup after shutdown, kill, and engine failure.
description: Protocol tests start a kernel registered from the tested commit and drive it through jupyter_client. Stream tests drive the PHP engine through the transport's Engine class with a slowed pipe reader.

cases.name: a cell ends only after its descriptor output has been read
the marker is found across a read boundary and never shown
a nul the cell writes itself is passed through
a cell that closes stdout still ends
the kernelspec starts the wrapper as a module
state carries from one cell to the next
a silent cell shows nothing but still reports an error
an engine killed mid cell is reported rather than hanging
an interrupt stops a running cell
stdout and stderr arrive in the order they were written
a cell that prints megabytes does not deadlock
what the engine writes to its own descriptors is streamed
the cursor is converted across a multibyte character
a kernel killed outright leaves no engine running
an orphaned engine in a runaway cell stops itself
the watchdog leaves a long cell and its sleep alone
a shutdown leaves no engine and no temporary directory
